bundle.shortDescription: Motion graphics from a sentence, made with local or cloud models
bundle.longDescription: Hash LMG turns a short brief into a designed, timed and scored motion-graphics film, with a model on your own computer or a cloud model on your own key. No account and no server of ours: requests go from your computer to the service you chose.
